summary_1line: Ravana orders Hanuman’s tail burned and paraded through Lanka, but Sita’s prayer protects him and he prepares to retaliate.

image_candidates.scene_text: Demons parade the bound Hanuman through Lanka’s streets with his long tail wrapped in burning cloth as crowds gather to watch.
Sita stands before the sacred fire praying that the flames on Hanuman’s tail turn cool and spare him harm.
Hanuman breaks his bonds at the city gate, towering like a mountain with his flaming tail blazing behind him as he seizes an iron bar.
